# What Nexis touches

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/cleaning_profile_policy.py - do not hand-edit. -->
<!-- Regenerate with: python3 scripts/cleaning_profile_policy.py -->

Every location the bundled System Cleaner profiles may delete, and every
location they are barred from touching. Generated from
`shared/nexis/cleaning_profiles/`; the rule behind the safety labels is in
[`CLEANING_PROFILES.md`](CLEANING_PROFILES.md) §4.

- **safe** — the owning app rebuilds the path on its own. Cleaned by every scan.
- **aggressive** — losing it costs a re-download, rebuild or offline access.
  Skipped unless the user turns on "Allow aggressive profiles".

Paths are globs; `$HOME` is the user's home directory.

## Never labelled safe (dangerous classes)

A `safe` profile path may not contain a segment run matching these patterns.

| Class | Why | Patterns |
|---|---|---|
| app-settings | Preferences and settings an app does not recreate to the user's liking. | `Preferences`<br>`Local State`<br>`settings.json`<br>`*.plist`<br>`registrymodifications.xcu` |
| keys | Keys, saved logins and session credentials. | `.ssh`<br>`.gnupg`<br>`keyrings`<br>`Keychains`<br>`Login Data`<br>`Cookies`<br>`*.pem`<br>`*.key`<br>`*.p12`<br>`*.kdbx` |
| history | Browsing, shell and recent-file history. | `History`<br>`Visited Links`<br>`Top Sites`<br>`places.sqlite`<br>`formhistory.sqlite`<br>`*_history`<br>`recently-used.xbel` |
| databases | Local databases and web storage that hold state, not derived data. | `*.sqlite`<br>`*.sqlite3`<br>`*.db`<br>`*.mdb`<br>`IndexedDB`<br>`Local Storage`<br>`Databases` |
| toolchains | Installed toolchains, SDKs, runtimes and VM or container state. | `.rustup`<br>`.nvm`<br>`.pyenv`<br>`.rbenv`<br>`.sdkman`<br>`.asdf`<br>`.volta`<br>`.cargo/bin`<br>`.gradle/wrapper`<br>`.gradle/jdks`<br>`toolchains`<br>`Toolchains`<br>`Android/Sdk`<br>`CoreSimulator/Devices`<br>`containers/storage/volumes`<br>`.wine/drive_c/Program Files*`<br>`.wine/drive_c/windows` |
| offline-data | Downloaded content or dependencies that are the only local copy: removing them breaks offline use until the user fetches them again. | `.m2/repository`<br>`.nuget/packages`<br>`.gradle/caches/modules-*`<br>`.cargo/registry`<br>`.cargo/git`<br>`.yarn/cache`<br>`.yarn/berry/cache`<br>`.pnpm-store`<br>`pnpm/store`<br>`.dropbox.cache`<br>`Mail Downloads`<br>`PersistentCache`<br>`Offline*`<br>`Spotify`<br>`spotify`<br>`Archives`<br>`*DeviceSupport` |
